name: smith-machine-front-squat.html
instructions:
1. Position the bar just underneath shoulder height.
2. Hold your arms straight out, step underneath the bar, and allow it to sit on top of your shoulders up against your neck.
3. Once the bar is in position, place one hand overtop each shoulder to stabilize the bar.
4. Take a breath and unrack the bar by rotating your wrists back to move the safeties.
5. Sit directly between your legs by simultaneously bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
6. Once your thighs reach parallel with the floor, reverse the movement by driving your feet into the floor and flexing your quads.
7. Finish the lift by exhaling as you fully extend the hips and knees.
